question: What is the key advantage of a generator function (using yield) over building and returning a full list?
options: Generators produce values lazily, one at a time, without holding the entire sequence in memory
Generators run faster on every possible workload
Generators can only be used once inside classes
explanation: yield pauses the function and produces one value at a time on demand, so a generator never needs to hold the whole sequence in memory at once — unlike a list.
